text.p: -- UBS Securities said that it upgraded Lam Research Corp and Novellus Systems Inc to buy from hold.
-- UBS noted that Applied Materials Inc announced the acquisitions of two small semiconductor capital equipment companies, Opal Inc and Orbot.

-- "We think these acquisitions could be the first round of a major consolidation phase for the semiconductor capital equipment industry. Size is increasingly a crucial factor for success," UBS said in a report.

-- UBS noted that Lam and Novellus Systems have had serious merger negotiations over the past few years. "We are raising our rating on both companies to a buy given consolidation speculation within the current market environment," it said.
-- Lam rose 11/16 to 34-3/4 and Novellus added 3/4 to 60-1/2.
